**Summary**  
Patient C3N-00852 has a moderate GNN-A out-of-fold risk of 0.50 for stage III–IV ccRCC, driven entirely by tumor-protein features (tumor_share=1.0) with no contribution from the recorded congestive-heart-failure phenotype [pred:C3N-00852:gnn]. - PPIP5K2 up-regulated (z=13.6) and top positive driver (score 0.165) [pt:C3N-00852:protein_up:NCBIGene:23262][contrib:C3N-00852:NCBIGene:23262]  
- P4HA2 (collagen hydroxylase) top driver (score 0.142); localized to nucleoplasm and collagen-biosynthesis pathway [contrib:C3N-00852:NCBIGene:8974][E3599126][E3831936]  
- DPP9 up-regulated (z=16.1) and driver (score 0.115) [pt:C3N-00852:protein_up:NCBIGene:91039][contrib:C3N-00852:NCBIGene:91039]

1. **STK33** (down-regulated, negative driver) – Fostamatinib binds STK33 [E342990]; also inhibits SRC [E333950] which connects to EGLN1/HIF pathway [E97295].  
2. **P4HA2** (top positive driver) – collagen biosynthesis pathway [E3831936]; no drug edge in subgraph.  
3. **PPIP5K2** (top positive driver) – no drug edge in subgraph.
